messages.content: 製作巧克力蛋糕應該準備哪些材料？

function.name: recipe_getTemperature

message.content:
以下是製作一個基本巧克力蛋糕所需的主要材料清單（約可做12片）：

| 材料 | 數量 |
|------|------|
| 中筋麵粉 (All‑purpose flour) | 1½ 杯 (190 g) |
| 細砂糖 | 1 杯 (200 g) |
| 可可粉 (無糖) | ¾ 杯 (75 g) |
| 泡打粉 (Baking powder) | 1 茶匙 (5 g) |
| 小蘇打粉 (Baking soda) | ½ 茶匙 (2.5 g) |
| 鹽 | ¼ 茶匙 (1.25 g) |
| 雞蛋 | 2 顆 (大約 100 g) |
| 牛奶 | 1 杯 (240 ml) |
| 植物油 (如菜籽油或葵花籽油) | ½ 杯 (120 ml) |
| 香草精 | 1 茶匙 (5 ml) |
| 熱水 (或熱咖啡，提升風味) | ½ 杯 (120 ml) |

> **備註**  
> - 若想要更濕潤、口感更豐富，可將牛奶替換為酸奶或優格。  
> - 如果你喜歡更濃郁的巧克力味道，可以加入 ½ 杯（80 g）碎黑巧克力或巧克力醬。  

這些材料組合起來即可烘焙出一道經典、柔軟且香甜的巧克力蛋糕。祝你烘焙愉快！
message.reasoning:
The user asks in Chinese: "製作巧克力蛋糕應該準備哪些材料？" meaning "What ingredients should I prepare to make chocolate cake?" They want a list of ingredients. There's no mention of temperature or oven type. So we don't need to call the function. Just answer with a list of ingredients.

We can provide a typical chocolate cake ingredient list: flour, sugar, cocoa powder, baking soda, baking powder, salt, eggs, milk, vegetable oil, vanilla extract, boiling water or coffee. Also optional: chocolate chips, etc.

We should respond in Chinese.
